dedupe_keys.name: ross mahdavi oil and gas data 1932 2014

description: Ross and Mahdavi publish a global country-level dataset of oil and natural-gas production, prices, exports and net exports. The Harvard Dataverse record covers oil production and prices from 1932 to 2014, gas from 1955 to 2014, and trade from 1986 to 2013. Country identifiers were revised to follow Correlates of War and Quality of Government standards. The provider publishes a tab-separated data file and a PDF codebook, free under CC0 1.0. A limitation is explicitly incomplete 2014 oil data; measurement units and annual-table structure require the codebook and were not assumed from the title. National aggregates do not describe individual wells, pipelines or trade routes. Simulation uses include calibrating historical fuel-supply scenarios and country-level resource dependence. It complements data-open-power-system-data with long-run oil and gas context. The canonical deposit and file manifest were checked, but neither data values nor the codebook were downloaded and no cross-country harmonisation was reproduced.
